title: About one in three sign-ins fails for Split and remote staff
scenario: A federation server with a clock seven minutes ahead after a host move rejects a share of the sign-ins in the app and in the browser; the engineer asks the farm admin for a health check and the time is corrected.

events.title: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: Teams and the web portal both fail for about one in three of our sign-in attempts since this morning, in the Split office and for remote workers alike. Some try three times before it works. Roughly 150 people have hit it. The message is 'Something went wrong' with a long correlation ID.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: Good morning, thank you. For my log search I need three affected people, each with one failure time in UTC. Please also say whether anything changed in your identity systems or your network during the last two days.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: People and times: b.kovac 08:12 UTC, a.maric 08:40 UTC, i.juric 09:05 UTC. Sign-in is federated here: we run our own farm of three AD FS servers. The only change I know of is that the hypervisor team moved the farm to a new host on Sunday evening.

events.title: Log search
events.text: Sign-in logs: a failed row exists for each of the three attempts. The failure reason points to the federation service, which could not validate the token it received from the identity provider.

events.title: Provider status
events.text: Provider status at 10:55 UTC: no incident for Teams, Entra ID or the web portal.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: Thank you. Since sign-in is federated, please ask the admin of the AD FS farm to check how healthy each of the three servers is, the token-signing certificate and the clock of every server, and to send me what they find.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: The farm admin reports at 12:30 UTC: servers 1 and 3 are healthy and their clocks agree with the domain controller. Server 2 has a clock that is 7 minutes ahead since the host move, and its event log is full of entries about tokens issued in the future. The signing certificate is valid on all three.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: That fits a failure rate of one in three. Please correct the time on server 2, or take that server out of the farm until the time is right, and tell me when it is done.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: Server 2 was taken out of the farm at 13:10 UTC. My own test sign-ins have all worked since.

events.title: Re: Sign-ins fail about one time in three
events.text: The time sync of the host was corrected at 15:00 UTC and server 2 is back in the farm. Its clock agrees with the others now.

events.title: Check after the correction
events.text: Check at 16:00 UTC: the sign-in failure rate of the last 60 minutes is 0 percent, against about 33 percent in the morning, and the three sample users signed in.
